correctness.rationale: For two positive distinct neighborhood queries U,V, their centers F are empty at Johnson distance>=3; distance2 has exactly 4 centers, while distance1 splits into A and B of sizes n-k-1 and k-1. The case split on t=|Q intersect S| and h=|Q intersect {a,b}| yields traces all F, co-singleton within A/B, or at most two centers. This proves Ldim(F)<=3, global dimension<=5; refined bound <=2 when min rank3, n<=9, or (10,5) gives global<=4. Lower bounds use actual certified depth4 J(6,3) and depth5 J(10,4) binary trees; independent leaf-path checking confirmed all 16+32 distinct witness centers; fixed-coordinate embeddings and rank complementation propagate to every parameter.
residual_risks: Outside interior rank only global upper bound; tree witnesses are finite but general upper/embedding proof supplies all n,k.
